Package com.example.helloworldproject.data

Class NotificationRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.helloworldproject.data.NotificationRepository
public class NotificationRepository extends Object
Repository for working with in-app notifications stored under:

profiles/{profileId}/notifications/{notificationId}

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration observeNotifications(@NonNull String profileId, @NonNull NotificationRepository.NotificationListListener listener)
      Observe all notifications for the given profile, ordered by most recent.

      listener - Callback that receives notification list updates.

    • createLotteryNotChosenNotification

      public void createLotteryNotChosenNotification(@NonNull String profileId, @NonNull String eventId, @NonNull String eventTitle)
      Create a "lottery not chosen" notification for the given profile.

      This method is typically called by the lottery logic when a user was not selected in the draw for a specific event.

      Parameters:
      profileId - Id of the entrant profile.
      eventId - Id of the event.
      eventTitle - Human friendly event title.

    • backfillChosenNotifications

      private void backfillChosenNotifications(@NonNull String profileId)
      Backfill notifications for any existing invites where the entrant was chosen but no notification document was ever created (e.g., invites created before the notifications feature existed). This keeps the Notifications screen from appearing empty for entrants who were already selected.
